svg.title: ELT: generation quality versus inference compute
svg.desc: Faithful vector-coordinate redraw of ELT Figure 4. Faded traces show model loop sweeps, stars reproduce the authors selected frontier points, hexagons show baselines. The dashed line is the reported fitted frontier. This plot varies model width and loop configurations, not sampling steps.
svg.text: Published vector coordinates · ImageNet 256 × 256 · lower FID is better
Source: Goyal et al., ELT, Figure 4 · Coordinates recovered from the published vector PDF; not raw experiment logs.
